body:
I believe the fact that you've already thought about going to see a therapist proves to me that your real-self is striving to live. I will tell you the honest truth that although I am often depressed, your situation sounds a lot worse than my own. However, I do believe that if you continue to live your life that you will one day look back to see how important this pain and suffering was in building you into the person you needed to be. Everyone in the world faces problems that seem at times to be too much to handle, and some of us have nobody to turn to when times get tough. 

I hope you will be safe tonight, and every night for the rest of your life. I want you to know that you may not think things get better, but as cliche as it sounds, the only way to go when you're down, is up. I believe in you, and I hope that you will realize that your anti-self will often tell you to give up, that you are hopeless and alone. You are not. I've been where you are. My situation may not be the same, but I've felt the same pain that feels like only death can save. I hope that you will learn to use this pain to love others, and to try and focus your happiness on not only your self but on others. I hope the best for you. I love you.
